The Bank of Smalltown has branches all over the world. It uses an intranet for the transfer of
information between branches. Customers are concerned about the security of their personal
data held in the bank’s computer systems. When a customer applies for a bank loan an expert
system is used to see if the loan can be approved.
The bank has a website for online banking.
The bank uses video conferencing suites for communication. It wishes to support schools by
providing the basic hardware and software to enable them to communicate with the bank and
with each other using video conferencing.
